oldBody:
- Sources: ROADMAP.md §7 owns approved order/current-next; COMPLETION_CHECKLIST.md owns required-item states; TASKS.md and Diagnostic Events own execution/problems; DECISIONS.md and game/UI/DESIGN contracts retain product/design authority.
- Read only relevant sections using the routing below. Resume from current files/Git and actual target state; old notes locate evidence, not new scope. No changed task fact means no repeat verification record.
- Before substantive work find the current stage, entry conditions, required checks and next eligible work. Open prerequisites block dependent work, not independently authorized work. Do not silently change scope/order.
- A finished task does not finish its stage/release. Review required outcomes and actual evidence before that claim. Pending/held items remain open; scope removal requires authority/reason and preserved history. Refresh affected checklist states and ROADMAP current-next from remaining conditions.
- Agreed recording uses existing TASKS/Diagnostic rules only: material work and reusable causes/fixes/remaining work, linked rather than duplicated. Questions, explanations and no-record requests cause no writes; no-record does not cancel separately authorized implementation. No background updates.
- After substantive work or a requested handoff, open with six short Korean bullets: 작업, 업데이트 파일, 이슈, 해결, 남은 문제, 다음 작업. One concrete fact each; 없음 when empty. 이슈 means a problem, 해결 a verified fix, 남은 문제 unresolved/unverified work. State actual changed files; keep technical completion and user acceptance separate. Add only necessary evidence/limits after the receipt. Simple questions need no receipt.
- If a source/write is unavailable, report the exact boundary and continue independent authorized work. Setup is not a routine work step; connection checks do not prove delivery to a fresh chat.
